interpretation: Outputs are bounded V4 parser candidates and performance measurements, not validated requirements, binary labels, precision estimates, probability samples, national samples, or economic measures.
performance_limits: Only four lexically selected provider files and the first at most 4000 physical rows per file are read in each region.
Whole-file audited byte size is storage context; selected-row Arrow and UTF-8 byte counts are the logical input-byte measures and do not measure filesystem or compressed Parquet I/O exactly.
Peak RSS is process ru_maxrss on Linux and is reported per worker; it is not simultaneous node-wide peak memory.
The Wuzhen Python 3.8 PyArrow location remains a read-only deployment discovery item; the wrapper fails rather than installing a package.
qualification_fields: qualification_expected, context_conflict, qualification_relation_unresolved, and all other parser fields remain in full CANDIDATE_JSON and are not collapsed into validated outcomes.
